gen-dafont-ethnocentric-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its line high. Ethnocentric, wide-spaced and fast, sits over it like neon tubing, so a plain sans body at a modest size lets that heading stay loud.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-merriweat: Spacey and a bit robotic, Alien Encounters spreads its letter pairs apart with a high x-height. Merriweather Sans is the sturdier one, making tall lowercase words look large, while the heading handles the otherworldly flair.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-public-sans: Azonix looks stamped and wide, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, every stroke the same thickness as the next. Public Sans keeps going comfortably with hefty, open letters.
gen-dafont-blockletter-manrope: Blockletter has a tall, squat belly in every letter, as if sketched by a pencil that never pressed harder. Manrope brings a bright open gap to each curve, which is the pair's best trick: precise up top, friendly below.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-bespoke-sans: Commanding from the first letter, Turret Road bends its round forms like open parentheses from one length of wire. Bespoke Sans lets the curves breathe with generous space before each stem, so the heading's wire stays the star.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-bespoke-sans: Wide-open horseshoe curves, no swelling anywhere. Underdog's rounded-nib heading hands off to Bespoke Sans, whose generous gaps near each stem make a longer plain sans passage feel sharp and unhurried.
gen-gf-unica-one-archivo: Archivo has a commanding x-height and curves that open outward rather than curling in. And Unica One, with its single-thickness strokes and big lowercase eye, gives a long passage a bold start before the sans-serif body carries it along easily.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-asap: Asap reads openly, its c forms like clean arcs and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. And Unica One's single line weight above it lets a long plain sans passage feel steady and readable.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and loose, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips on a wire-like skeleton. Shrink Unica One or enlarge this sans-serif, and the two lose their order.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-fira-sans: Unica One's lowercase eye is huge, with daylight inside every curve. Fira Sans does the quieter work, its sans-serif s curves opening wide and its x-height running large, while the heading simply grabs attention.
